import json,hashlib,numpy as np; from pathlib import Path; from pipeline.pillar_packing import pack_points
trusted=json.loads(Path('/mnt/trusted.json').read_text()); points=[]; offsets=[]; n=0
for r in trusted['rows']:
 p=Path('/source/reconstruction')/r['artifact']; assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256']
 with np.load(p,allow_pickle=False) as a:
  physical=np.concatenate((a['xyz'],a['physical_features'][:,1:2]),axis=1); assert physical.shape==(r['points'],4); points.append(physical); offsets.append({'row':r,'start':n,'end':n+len(physical)}); n+=len(physical)
original=np.concatenate(points); result=pack_points(original,roi=(-64.,-64.,-3.,64.,64.,5.),cell_size=(.25,.25),max_pillars=20000,max_points=32,seed=17)
valid=result['source_indices']>=0; indices=result['source_indices'][valid]; assert len(indices)==len(np.unique(indices)); np.testing.assert_array_equal(result['points'][valid],original[indices])
assert result['counts_report']['input_points']==n; assert np.all(result['counts']==valid.sum(axis=1)); assert np.all(result['source_indices'][~valid]==-1)
np.savez('/outputs/packed.npz',points=result['points'],counts=result['counts'],coordinates=result['coordinates'],source_indices=result['source_indices'])
Path('/outputs/check.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':'native all-sensor/both-return packing source identity reconciled','frame':{'context':trusted['rows'][0]['context'],'timestamp':trusted['rows'][0]['timestamp']},'sources':offsets,'counts_report':result['counts_report'],'grid':result['grid'],'scope':'engineering frame only; no scientific training or held-out claim'},indent=2)); print('PASS native packing',result['counts_report'])
